independent_outbox_recheck.scope: Race fix independently checked before the additive pending-cancellation change; the final 55-test suite and cancellation probes check final bytes.

findings.reproduction: Purge returned PURGED while historic reviewed or crash-staging inquiry copies remained in work_root.
findings.fix: Bounded ordinary, historical review and crash-staging Case paths are preflighted for symlinks and deleted under the Case lock; unrelated Case paths are preserved.
findings.verification: 18 maintenance tests passed, including actual kernel-layout historical and crash-staging regression tests.

findings.reproduction: A pending draft request_changes during DISPATCHING advanced Case version and invalidated an already sending action; reverse ordering left old mail approval usable before workflow wake.
findings.fix: Require current approved draft review at external authorization creation, decision, enqueue and dispatch; block draft decisions during uncertain/inflight delivery; atomically invalidate external approvals for negative decisions; fence resumed workflow draft writes.
findings.verification: Original admission now403; negative delayed-wake authorization403; legacy inflight states409; no denied-probe FakeMail calls.

findings.reproduction: An approval-invalidated PENDING action could remain after closing the Case and block retention indefinitely.
findings.fix: Version-checked admin/reviewer cancellation allows only PENDING -> CANCELLED under the same Case lock as dispatch; Case close atomically cancels remaining PENDING rows.
findings.verification: Three cancellation regressions plus independent role/tenant/version/input probes and blocked-dispatch cancellation409; one explicitly authorized FakeMail call completes once, zero real external calls.

verdict: No remaining reproducible P1 identified within the reviewed subjects and tested scenarios.
limits: Not a whole-product penetration test or production authorization.
All API/action probes used temporary SQLite databases, synthetic fixtures and fake connectors.
No live SMTP/CRM writes or paid model/API calls were executed.
Real provider contracts, credentials, source licenses, TLS deployment and production retention/backups require deployment-specific validation.
